workshoptitle: Build AI Applications with Oracle Autonomous AI Vector Database and Python

tutorials.title: Get Started: Log In to the LiveLabs Sandbox
tutorials.description: Request a LiveLabs Sandbox reservation and access its login information.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Working with the Vector Database Console
tutorials.description: Retrieve the REST URL, review embedding models, and explore the Vector Database Console.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Get Started with Oracle Machine Learning Notebooks
tutorials.description: Open OML, create a notebook, and run a Python paragraph.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Install oracle-vecdb package
tutorials.description: Install oracle-vecdb, configure a client, and test the database connection.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Understand Models, Records, and Vector Tables
tutorials.description: Create integrated embedding and bring-your-own-vector tables.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Create Embeddings and Load Text
tutorials.description: Load sample records and generate embeddings.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Run Baseline Semantic Search
tutorials.description: Search by meaning and filter by metadata.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Create a Query Memory Module
tutorials.description: Save prior queries and use them to produce memory-aware park searches.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Create Indexes for Approximate Search (Optional)
tutorials.description: Optional HNSW and IVF query-timing comparison.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help.
